name: trail-code
description: Trail-code code context graph for OpenClaude — build a repo's wiring graph + per-file cards as linked markdown. 6 MCP tools (trail_find_code, trail_find_all, trail_trace_calls, trail_file_api, trail_repo_map, trail_check_freshness) + auto hooks that inject relevant graph context into every prompt, rebuild the graph after edits, and track token savings. Requires `npm install -g @trailhq/trail-code` (CLI: `trail`).
